text:
- iyati sākṣāt śivaḥ kartā — so far directly Śiva maker. [tsa-a08-v18] (R) [CLM-001]
- aśuddhaṃ punar adhvānam anantāparanāmāghoreśaḥ sṛjati — impure path Aghoreśa-Ananta emits. [tsa-a08-v18] (R) [CLM-002]
- īśvarecchāvaśena prakṣubdhabhogalolikānām aṇūnāṃ bhogasiddhyartham — by Lord's will, for wavered atoms' enjoyment-perfection. [tsa-a08-v18] (R) [CLM-003]
- Aghoreśa-Ananta emits the impure path for craving atoms. [tsa-a08-v18] (R) [CLM-004]
- tatra loliko 'pūrṇam anyatārūpaḥ parispandaḥ akarmakam abhilāṣamātram eva bhaviṣyad avacchedayogyateti — waverer, incomplete, other-natured throbbing, mere longing, future fitness for bounding. [tsa-a08-v19] (R) [CLM-005]
- na malaḥ puṃsas tattvāntaram — not man's impurity nor another category. [tsa-a08-v19] (R) [CLM-006]
- Craving = mere longing, not impurity, no new category. [tsa-a08-v19] (R) [CLM-007]
- rāgatattvaṃ tu karmāvacchinno 'bhilāṣaḥ — passion-principle is action-bounded longing. [tsa-a08-v20] (R) [CLM-008]
- Passion = bounded longing. [tsa-a08-v20] (R) [CLM-009]
- karma tu tatra karmamātraṃ buddhidharmas tu rāgaḥ — action is mere action there; mind-nature is passion. [tsa-a08-v21] (R) [CLM-010]
- karmabhedacitra iti vibhāgo vakṣyate — varied by action-difference; distinction to be told. [tsa-a08-v21] (R) [CLM-011]
- Action mere; passion mind-nature; distinction deferred. [tsa-a08-v21] (R) [CLM-012]
- so 'yaṃ malaḥ parameśvarasya svātmapracchādanecchātaḥ — this impurity: from the Lord's self-veiling wish. [tsa-a08-v22] (R) [CLM-013]
- nānyat kiṃcid vastv api — nothing else at all a thing. [tsa-a08-v22] (R) [CLM-014]
- ca tatparameśvarecchātmanaiva dharāder api vastutvāt — and by that Lord-wish-nature alone is earth-and-rest's thingness. [tsa-a08-v22] (R) [CLM-015]
- Impurity = Lord's self-veiling wish; nothing else; things real only thus. [tsa-a08-v22] (R) [CLM-016]
- sa ca malo vijñānakevale vidyamāno dhvaṃsonmukha iti na svakāryaṃ karma āpyāyati — existing in knowledge-kevalin, facing destruction: does not fatten its effect-action. [tsa-a08-v23] (R) [CLM-017]
- pralayakevalasya tu jṛmbhamāṇa eva āsta iti malopodbalitaṃ karma saṃsāravaicitryabhoge nimittam — but yawning in dissolution-kevalin: impurity-strengthened action causes transmigration-variety-enjoyment. [tsa-a08-v23] (R) [CLM-018]
- Knowledge-kevalin starves action; dissolution-kevalin fuels it. [tsa-a08-v23] (R) [CLM-019]
- tadbhogavāsanānuviddhānām aṇūnāṃ bhogasiddhaye śrīmān aghoreśaḥ sṛjati — for enjoyment-pierced atoms' perfection, glorious Aghoreśa emits. [tsa-a08-v24] (R) [CLM-020]
- iti yuktam uktam — fittingly said. [tsa-a08-v24] (R) [CLM-021]
- malasya ca prakṣobha īśvarecchābalād eva — impurity's stirring by Lord-wish-force alone. [tsa-a08-v24] (R) [CLM-022]
- Enjoyment-need + inert inability ground Aghoreśa's emission. [tsa-a08-v24] (R) [CLM-023]
- aṇur nāma kila cidacidrūpāvabhāsa eva — atom: mere conscious-unconscious shining. [tsa-a08-v25] (R) [CLM-024]
- tasya cidrūpam aiśvaryam eva — conscious form is lordliness. [tsa-a08-v25] (R) [CLM-025]
- acidrūpataiva malaḥ — unconscious-formedness alone impurity. [tsa-a08-v25] (R) [CLM-026]
- Atom = shining; impurity = unconscious side; Māyā-principle inert-pervading material cause; Māyā-power distinct. [tsa-a08-v25] (R) [CLM-027]
